```{r}
library(parallel)
library(doFuture)
library(foreach)
library(progressr)
library(future)

if(detectCores() >= 30) {
  numCores = 25
}

registerDoFuture()
plan(multisession, workers = numCores)

handlers("progress")

required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "rjags", "HDInterval")
```

```{r}
### Simulation Size
N_iter  <- 1000 # Number of iterations


### MCMC definitions
Iterations <- 2500
Burn_in <- 2500


### Each Situation we wish to simulate through
Z4.types        <- c("Categorical", "Continuous")
T_Effects       <- c(0.50, 1.00)
H_Effects       <- c(0.00, 0.50, 1.00)
Noise.Vars_list <- c(10)
Outcome_SDs     <- c(0.50, 1.00)
N_trials        <- c(50, 100, 200)


### Simulation outcomes
Heterogeneity_List <- list()
```

```{r}
### Simulation Study -----------------------------------------------------------------



### Declarations ---------------------------------------------------------------

Z4.type    <- Z4.types[1]         # Z4 Definition
Noise.Vars <- Noise.Vars_list[1]  # Number of Noise Variables
Outcome_SD <- Outcome_SDs[1]


### Looping over Simulation Parameters -----------------------------------------

#for(i in 1:length(T_Effects)) {
T_Effect <- T_Effects[2]

#for(j in 1:length(H_Effects)) {
H_Effect <- H_Effects[3]
  
### Creating the base file path for simulation ---------------------------------
base_path <- paste0(getwd(), "/Output/",
               Z4.type, "/",
               "TrtEff_", T_Effect, "-HetEff_", H_Effect, "/")
if (!dir.exists(base_path)) {
  dir.create(base_path)
}

for(k in 1:length(N_trials))  {
N_trial  <- N_trials[k]  

### Simulation -----------------------------------------------------------------

Heterogeneity_List <- with_progress({

p <- progressor(along = 1:N_iter)

foreach(i = 1:N_iter, .options.future = list(seed = TRUE,
                                             packages = required_packages)                              ) %dofuture% {
  
  p(sprintf("iteration %d", i))
  
  Trial_Data <- Gen_Trial_Data(N_trial, 
                               Z4.type, 
                               Noise.Vars, 
                               T_Effect = T_Effect, H_Effect = T_Effect, 
                               Outcome_SD = Outcome_SD)
    
  Heterogeneity <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                      SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                      Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                      Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity)
  
  if(Noise.Vars >= 1) {
    Heterogeneity_Noise <- Risk_Heterogeneity(Trial_Data, Burn_in, Iterations, 
                                              SSVS_script = model_string.SSVS,
                                              Risk_script = model_string.Risk, 
                                              Heterogeneity_script = model_string.Heterogeneity,
                                              Optimized = FALSE) 
    }
  
  Alternative_Results <- Alternative_Methods(Trial_Data, Noise.Vars)
  
  Output <- Clean_Output(Trial_Data, 
                         Heterogeneity, 
                         Heterogeneity_Noise, 
                         Alternative_Results, 
                         N_trial, Noise.Vars)
    
  list(Output = Output,
       Selection_Probability = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Selection_Probability},
       Variable_Selections = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Variable_Selections},
       R_hat_Heterogeneity = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat )) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Heterogeneity$R_hat},
       R_hat_Risk = if(is.null(Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat)) {"N/A"}
                               else{Heterogeneity$Risk$Risk$R_hat})
}

})


### Storing results separately -------------------------------------------------
Results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Output"))
Selection_Probability <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Selection_Probability")
Variable_Selections <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "Variable_Selections")
R_hat_Heterogeneity <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Heterogeneity")
R_hat_Risk <- lapply(Heterogeneity_List, `[[`, "R_hat_Risk")


### Saving Results -------------------------------------------------------------

### Results .csv file
path <- paste0(base_path,
               "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars, "-OutcomeSD_", Outcome_SD, ".csv")
write_csv(Results, path)


### Selection Probability .rds file
select_path <- paste0(base_path, "1-Selection_Probability/")
if (!dir.exists(select_path)) {
  dir.create(select_path)
}
write_rds(Selection_Probability, paste0(select_path,
               "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars, "-OutcomeSD_", Outcome_SD,
                "-SelectProb.rds"))


### Variable Selections .rds file
VarSelect_path <- paste0(base_path, "2-Variable_Selection/")
if (!dir.exists(VarSelect_path)) {
  dir.create(VarSelect_path)
}
write_rds(Variable_Selections, paste0(VarSelect_path,
               "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars, "-OutcomeSD_", Outcome_SD,
                "-VarSelection.rds"))


### Diagnostics .rds files
diag_path <- paste0(base_path, "3-Diagnostics/")
if (!dir.exists(diag_path)) {
  dir.create(diag_path)
}
write_rds(list(R_hat_Risk, R_hat_Heterogeneity), 
          paste0(diag_path,
                 "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars, "-OutcomeSD_", Outcome_SD,
                 "-Diag.rds"))


### Printing Simulation Details ------------------------------------------------

Summary_Print <- Results |>
  summarise(
    Power.Risk = sum(rejection.Risk == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Risk_Noise = sum(rejection.Risk_Noise == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Intx = sum(rejection.interaction == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.Intx_adj = sum(rejection.interaction_adj == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
    Power.SDIR = sum(rejection.SDIR == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter
  )


cat(paste(
  "*****************************************************",
  "\nSimulation Completed:\n",
  "\nNumber of Iterations: ", N_iter," \n",
  "    Trial Size: ", N_trial, "\n",
  "    Treatment Effect: ", T_Effect, "; Heterogeneity Effect: ", H_Effect, "\n",
  "   ", Z4.type, " Definition of Z4", "\n",
  "   ", Noise.Vars, " Noise variables considered\n",
  "\nPower Summary:", "\n",
  "   Optimized Model: ", Summary_Print[1], "\n",
  "   Non-optimized Model: ", Summary_Print[2], "\n",
  "   Interaction: ", Summary_Print[3], "\n",
  "   Interaction (Adjusted):", Summary_Print[4], "\n",
  "   SDIR: ", Summary_Print[5], "\n",
  "\n*****************************************************"
  )
)

}

t <- Plotting_Output(base_path, Outcome_SD)

### Plots .jpg file
plot_path <- paste0(base_path, "4-Plots/")
if (!dir.exists(plot_path)) {
  dir.create(plot_path)
}
ggsave(paste0(plot_path, 
              "N_", N_trial, "-Noise_", Noise.Vars, "-OutcomeSD_", Outcome_SD,
              "-Plot.jpg"))
```

```{r}
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtext)

base_path <- paste0(getwd(), "/Output/",
               Z4.type, "/",
               "TrtEff_", T_Effect, "-HetEff_", H_Effect, "/")




list_csvs <- lapply(file_names, read_csv)
names(list_csvs) <- c(100, 200, 50)

Power <- map_dfr(list_csvs, function(df) {
  df |>
    summarise(
      Power.Risk = sum(rejection.Risk == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
      Power.Risk_Noise = sum(rejection.Risk_Noise == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
      Power.Intx = sum(rejection.interaction == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
      Power.Intx_adj = sum(rejection.interaction_adj == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter,
      Power.SDIR = sum(rejection.SDIR == "Reject", na.rm = TRUE) / N_iter
      ) },
  .id = "N") |>
  mutate(N = as.numeric(N))

Power |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Power"),
    names_to = "Method",
    values_to = "Power"
  ) |>
  mutate(Method = str_remove(Method, "Power.")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = N, y = Power, colour = Method)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
```
